node.statement: Applying lem-compcb-rectangular-product to (R_Y,C_X), then using the product and norm identities above, gives ||Co_Q(Y^dagger X)-Y^dagger X|| <= C_rc*e*||Y||*||X||. Since the fixed data were arbitrary and C_rc,e_rc are universal with e_rc>0, node 1 follows.
